properties: issuer, principal and agent revocation callbacks with fail-closed behavior
bounded envelope lifetime and clock skew

trust_boundaries.private_key_custody: External trusted signer or KMS/HSM; not implemented in this repository module.
trust_boundaries.issuer_revocation: Injected callback must read a durable trusted registry; deployment wiring remains open.
trust_boundaries.runtime_authorization: Successful envelope verification authenticates claims but does not itself authorize capabilities or execute tasks. The receiving runtime must independently enforce principal identity, capability policy, state version and ActionGate.
trust_boundaries.replay_store: SQLite provides local crash-persistent one-use nonce consumption. Shared multi-node replay protection requires a deployment-grade shared transactional store or equivalent protocol.

integration_gates: Wire verifier to the primary runtime ingress before any federated task is accepted.
Bind issuer revocation callback to durable identity/key tombstones.
Add cross-process and concurrent replay tests against the deployment database.
Add sender-to-receiver integration tests covering policy version mismatch, stale state, key rotation and revocation.
Keep transport adapters unidirectional and deny-by-default until cross-repository tests pass.
non_goals: No private signing key is stored in the runtime.
No distributed consensus or multi-region replay guarantee is claimed.
No authorization decision is delegated to the envelope signature alone.
